newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles tumbles on newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles tumbles on newspaper report.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International Plc dropped on Friday after a Financial Times report raised concerns that the company had delayed striking a deal with U.S. pharmaceutical giant Johnson and Johnson, dealers said.
Biocompatibles shares tumbled 80p to 11.95 stg by 0753 GMT.
The report said analysts were concerned that Johnson and Johnson had allowed an option to adopt Biocompatible's coatings for medical implants to expire.
But some analysts said the expiration of the option was a technicality and added the two companies were still in dialogue about a deal.

"The point is the two companies are still sitting around the table and they could negotiate a deal that would mean a lot more to Biocompatibles than originally envisaged," said Erling Refsum, analyst at Yamaichi Securities.
No one at Biocompatibles was available for immediate comment.
